**Finding submitted: deviation (AUDIT), fallback target.**

- **Responsive clause:** §3.4 (p0022) is the sole provision binding the Company to an inspection right — searches for audit/inspection/verification/records returned no other hits, and no audit heading exists in the outline.
- **Already at or above fallback:** 30 days' prior written notice (vs. 15-day floor), HDI bears inspection costs unconditionally (vs. "unless underpayment exceeds 10%"), plus scope limited to payment-calculation records during normal business hours.
- **Failure:** no frequency limit at all, so inspections could be repeated without restriction — fails the fallback once-per-year element and drifts toward the walk-away position.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** one surgical insertion adding "no more than once per year" into the existing sentence, leaving notice, business-hours and cost language verbatim. Preferred-only elements (independent auditor, confidentiality, off-site, no systems access) were deliberately not volunteered at the fallback target.
